answer: Issue each agent one capability lease signed under a willow key, renewed only after independent auditors replay its signed work log and verify the claimed jobs actually happened. A sybil farmer must then forge a complete, checkable history for every clone, paying audit and compute costs per identity instead of once. A public river of revoked leases lists every caught identity, so a clone cannot quietly re-register under a fresh name, and each lease carries a modest saffron bond slashed on fraud. Cloning stays possible but stops scaling, while honest agents renew cheaply on real work.
